text:
5 handbags everyone is wearing in Paris right now 🇫🇷
If you want to understand real Parisian handbag style, it is not only about the most obvious designer bags. In Paris, the bags French women actually wear are often practical, understated, and easy to style every day.
Mini Marly by Ateliers Auguste
A chic everyday French bag — structured, minimal, and very Parisian without feeling too obvious.
Céline Bucket Bag
The perfect understated designer bag. Elegant, discreet, and easy to wear with jeans, tailoring, or a simple summer dress.
Le City by Balenciaga
The cool-girl Paris bag. A little messy, effortless, nostalgic, and perfect if you like a more relaxed French style.
Longchamp Le Pliage
The real-life French woman bag. Practical, lightweight, and still one of the most common bags you will see in Paris.
Saint Louis by Goyard
The old-money Parisian tote. Spacious, classic, and instantly recognizable, but still more discreet than many logo bags.
Parisian handbag style is all about balance: practical but elegant, designer but not too flashy, polished but never too perfect.
